name: Hinasaki Aoi
source:
She is a neat, cheerful, and popular person. She is a childhood friend of Hiroto, the main character.

She likes Hiroto, but he does not notice her. She is a bit disappointed by this.

[From [url=https://www.appetite-game.com/apt_226.html#character]official site[/url]]
